proposition: Despite age and frail health Ibn Turka travelled to Herat, gained Shāhrukh's favour and temporarily silenced his enemies; Shāhrukh offered to restore him as qadi of Isfahan, but he chose Yazd to escape intriguers (Yazd being the most stable and politically quiescent city of Fars); the timeline says he was given the judgeship of Yazd.

mediation.who: first Herat hearing and the move to Yazd
Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I (829/1426), addressed to Shāhrukh
mediation.note: 'age and frail health' and the reason for choosing Yazd are his own
